task.description:
Fix failing integration tests on feature/WF02-env-batch1-20260610.

FAILING TESTS:
1. TC-ENV-02-03 (env02_test.zig:380) — Cross-schema isolation check: verify that a connection in test tenant T-test cannot read data from production tenant T schema. The test may be wrong (checking for an error when 0 rows is acceptable), or the isolation logic may need adjustment. Fix whichever is incorrect.

2. TC-ENV-03-01 (env03_test.zig) — POST /promote happy path: returns HTTP 201 with DRAFT definition. Likely a route registration or handler bug in src/definition/promotion.zig or src/main.zig.

3. TC-ENV-03-02 (env03_test.zig) — Audit entries created on both tenants with action=DEFINITION_PROMOTED.

4. TC-ENV-03-05 (env03_test.zig) — Version increment: if name already exists on production, version=max+1.

Steps:
1. Read the test report and the failing test files to understand the exact failures.
2. Check src/definition/promotion.zig and src/main.zig for the promotion route.
3. Fix the root causes in the source code.
4. Run: zig build && zig build test && set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test && zig build test-integration-env (or test-integration)
5. All 4 previously-failing tests must now PASS.
6. Commit the fix to feature/WF02-env-batch1-20260610 and push.

result.summary: Fixed 4 root causes: (1) wrong defer order in env02/env03 tests (LIFO + ON DELETE RESTRICT), (2) writePromotionAudit jsonb_build_object parameter type bug -> build JSON in Zig, (3) TC-ENV-03-02 queried audit_log instead of audit_entries, (4) incomplete defer for export_doc graph allocation. Updated clean_test_db.py to clear test tenant rows in FK-safe order. All 4 ENV tests now pass. Committed to feature/WF02-env-batch1-20260610.
